description: Transform source content into multiple formats. Just paste content: we'll generate the 5 most useful formats by default, or specify exactly what you need.

key_message.description: Optional: Core message to emphasize across all formats

source_content.description: Original content to repurpose (blog post, article, transcript, etc.)

source_type.description: What type of content is the source

target_formats.description: OPTIONAL: Formats to generate (comma-separated). Defaults to: linkedin_post, twitter_thread, email, blog_summary, quote_cards. Other options: infographic_outline, video_script, podcast_talking_points, slide_deck_outline, newsletter_section

name: content_repurposer
title: Content Repurposer
